title_en: Reply of the Supreme People's Court on the Issue of Who Shall Bear Liability for Damages When a Stolen Motor Vehicle Causes a Traffic Accident

articles.content_en:
Higher People's Court of Henan Province:
We have received your Request for Instructions on Who Shall Bear Liability for Damages When the Perpetrator Flees After a Traffic Accident Involving a Stolen Motor Vehicle. Upon review, we reply as follows:
When a traffic accident occurs involving a stolen motor vehicle, causing material loss to the victim, the perpetrator shall bear tort liability for damages according to law, and the owner of the stolen motor vehicle shall not bear liability for damages.
This is our reply.
